headline.purpose: Section titles such as Runs and Findings.

title.purpose: A batch id or a step id.

motion.name: underline-draw
motion.purpose: A link underline draws in from the left. Reduced motion shows the underline at rest.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The action on a filter or a note. Square, indigo, flat.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #12315c; color: #f7f8f6; border: 0; border-radius: 0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; font-family: "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0c2244; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #12315c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A name or a note. Square stroke, sheet fill.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; color: #12315c; font-family: "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #1a1c19; border: 1px solid #12315c; border-radius: 0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.5rem; font: inherit; caret-color: #12315c; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #12315c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Running head
components.description: The pinned indigo bar. The title is the batch id once a batch is open.
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; min-height: 4.25rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.75rem; background: #12315c; color: #f7f8f6; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgb(18 49 92 / 18%); } .ds-head strong { font-family: "Source Serif 4", Palatino, serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-head span { color: #d5deea; font-family: "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; }

components.name: Result word
components.description: Severity is a word, not a pill.
components.html: Critical Needs Review No Findings
components.css: .ds-result { font-family: "Source Sans 3", sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #1a1c19; } .ds-critical { color: #9e2a2b; font-weight: 600; } .ds-review { color: #6f3d09; font-weight: 600; } .ds-clear { color: #1a1c19; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Specification row
components.description: One stored batch. The id is the serif link. The result is a word.
components.html: B26-0413Synthetol 500 mg film-coated tabletsCritical

narrative.overview:
The screen is a specification index a reviewer can sit in. A pinned indigo running head names the page, a hairline table carries the records, and the batch id is set in Source Serif 4. Density is the density of a monograph: tight rows, tabular figures, and prose held to a readable measure. The page is light because the work happens at a desk in ordinary office light.

Color does three jobs. The indigo bar is the shell. Critical and Needs Review are words in their own colors, on the paper, never pills. No Findings stays in the same ink as the rest of the row.
keyCharacteristics: A pinned indigo running head, with the batch id in Source Serif 4
Hairline tables on cool paper, square corners, no sidebar
Severity is the word itself: Critical, Needs Review, or No Findings
One motion: a link underline that draws in from the left

rules.name: The Word Carries the Result Rule
rules.body: Critical, Needs Review, and No Findings are colored words. They are not pills, badges, or row fills.

rules.name: The Serif Is the Identifier Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 is for a batch id or a step id. It is not a display face for sentences.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The running head is the only elevated surface. Rows, notes, and buttons stay flat.

dos: Do keep the running head pinned and indigo, and set the batch id in Source Serif 4.
Do show Critical, Needs Review, and No Findings as those words.
Do keep comments and notes as text, with a readable measure.
Do use a hairline, not a card, to separate rows.
donts: Don't add a sidebar, a status pill, or a colored row fill for severity.
Don't put a second shadow on tables, notes, or buttons.
Don't round the button or the fields.
Don't set sentences in Source Serif 4.
